scope: Blind-use API defects, rich title adaptation and discovery improvements; no renderer or CI thresholds changed.

findings.before: First bounded construction omitted names set on the same Axes beforehand.
findings.after: The common categorical/box constructor transfers X/Y names by orientation; explicit category/value names, including empty strings, take precedence.

findings.before: The title helper copied newlines into the legacy single-line field and validation failed.
findings.after: A shared rich-title adapter preserves full wording/segments and derives only the legacy fallback; construction, setters and title-token replay use it.

findings.before: Extracted rich-title appearance applied to a legacy-only destination produced an incomplete text object without segments.
findings.after: Seed the destination title before merging an appearance patch, preserving its wording and data.

findings.before: README said multi-panel figures were unsupported.
findings.after: Quick-start grid example and matching capability limits distinguish Cartesian/polar grids from separate bounded Figures.

convenience.legend: Four Cartesian corners through Axes.legend(loc=...) or Figure.update(legend, corner=...); secondary Axes own their legend. Bounded loc requests reject atomically.
convenience.inversion: Cartesian X/Y toggle preserves limits/ticks and follows shared axes. Secondary Y stays local; bounded/polar requests reject atomically.
convenience.discovery: plot/scatter/imshow/title/axis-name/legend docstrings, tick-spacing alternatives and category-newline error guidance.

contracts: Complete bounded-model equality and exact native output for names set before versus after first construction.
Rich title text/style preservation before construction, after edits, token JSON and code replay.
Legacy-only destination title preserved under appearance-only application.
Valid 401-character title kept in full; invalid rich-title lengths/line counts/control characters leave settings and revision unchanged.
Panel/shared-axis/secondary-axis inversion and legend ownership; unsupported requests do not mutate state.

validation.preflight: actionlint, shellcheck, asset provenance, pinned maturin-action workflow contract and tests passed

presentation.pixel_expectation: Two separate red text bands of at least ten rows and more than 150 colored pixels on a 700x500 canvas, plus accepted axis names and complete title SSOT.
presentation.negative_control: The same assertion rejects a black canvas and an actual single-line native title.
presentation.environment: Linux X11, Mesa lavapipe native, Chromium SwiftShader WebGPU; the notebook kernel import path is asserted to match the test runner installed package.

limitations: No arbitrary-position tick API was added.
Bounded category/axis labels remain single-line; rich title limits remain enforced by the upstream model.
Raw apply_settings/configure patches must still satisfy both legacy and rich-title model constraints.
Static native output and the focused notebook/native checks do not establish Windows GUI correctness, physical GPU performance or every editor interaction.
GitHub CI status is tracked separately from these local measurements.
